name: Faire
description: Let your AI read your Faire brand account: wholesale orders with their items, shipments and payout, your product catalog with variants and prices, and inventory by SKU or variant. Read-only, through the Faire External API v2.
instructions:
This connector reads a brand's data on Faire, the wholesale marketplace, through the Faire External API v2 (https://www.faire.com/external-api/v2). It is read-only: it lists and fetches orders, products and inventory, and never accepts, ships, cancels or edits anything.

**Authentication**: Faire's API uses OAuth. Register an app in the Faire Developer Portal to get an application ID and secret, let the brand authorize it (scopes READ_BRAND, READ_ORDERS, READ_PRODUCTS, READ_INVENTORIES), and exchange the code for an access token. Every request sends two headers: X-FAIRE-OAUTH-ACCESS-TOKEN (the access token) and X-FAIRE-APP-CREDENTIALS (applicationId:applicationSecret, Base64-encoded).

**Identifiers**: orders start with bo_ (e.g. bo_bxdmjbwxid; the Faire website shows it as #BXDMJBWXID, the display_id). Products start with p_ (p_123), variants with po_, brands with b_. Inventory is looked up by your own SKUs or by Faire variant IDs.

**Pagination and limits**: list tools return a cursor; pass it back as cursor to get the next page, and stop when it is empty. limit sets the page size (up to 50 here). Filter by updated_at_min (ISO 8601) to fetch only what changed since a date. Faire answers 429 when a token sends too many requests; wait and retry.

**Money**: amounts come as integer minor units with a currency, e.g. {"amount_minor": 1250, "currency": "USD"} is 12.50 USD. Older *_cents fields carry the same value.

**Common workflows**: list new orders (faire_list_orders with excluded_states to skip DELIVERED and CANCELED), then open one with faire_get_order for the full address and payout. List products, then check stock for their SKUs with faire_get_inventory_by_skus. Start with faire_get_brand_profile to confirm which brand the token belongs to.

**Limitations**: no write tools yet (accepting, shipping or cancelling orders, editing products, setting inventory or prices). Retailer profiles, reviews and prepacks are not covered. OAuth works only with External API v2.
prerequisites: A Faire brand account and an app registered in the Faire Developer Portal that the brand has authorized, with an OAuth access token. About 10 minutes.

FAIRE_OAUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN.label: OAuth access token
FAIRE_OAUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN.help: The access token Faire returns when you exchange the authorization code after the brand approves your app. Sent as X-FAIRE-OAUTH-ACCESS-TOKEN.
FAIRE_OAUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste only the token, without spaces.

FAIRE_APP_CREDENTIALS.label: App credentials (Base64)
FAIRE_APP_CREDENTIALS.help: Your app's applicationId:applicationSecret from the Faire Developer Portal, Base64-encoded, e.g. the output of: printf 'APP_ID:APP_SECRET' | base64. Sent as X-FAIRE-APP-CREDENTIALS.
FAIRE_APP_CREDENTIALS.patternMessage: Paste the Base64 value of applicationId:applicationSecret, not the raw ID and secret.

verifyHints.401: Faire refused the credentials. Check that FAIRE_OAUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN is a current OAuth token for this brand and that FAIRE_APP_CREDENTIALS is the Base64 of applicationId:applicationSecret for the same app.
verifyHints.403: The token works but lacks a scope. Ask the brand to authorize the app again with READ_BRAND, READ_ORDERS, READ_PRODUCTS and READ_INVENTORIES.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Faire is rate limiting this token. Wait a minute and try again.

tools.name: faire_get_brand_profile
tools.description: Get the Faire brand the credentials belong to: brand ID (b_...), name, currency and locale. No parameters. Use it first to confirm the connection and the brand's currency. Read-only.

tools.name: faire_list_orders
tools.description: List the brand's Faire wholesale orders, oldest update first, with state, retailer, ship dates, items (SKU, quantity, price), shipments and total payout. Use excluded_states to skip finished orders and updated_at_min to fetch only recent changes; pass the returned cursor to get the next page. Read-only.

cursor.description: The cursor from the previous page's response. Leave empty for the first page.

updated_at_min.description: Only orders updated at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z.

created_at_min.description: Only orders created at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

excluded_states.description: Comma-separated order states to leave out, e.g. DELIVERED,CANCELED. States: NEW, PROCESSING, PRE_TRANSIT, IN_TRANSIT, DELIVERED, CANCELED, BACKORDERED, PENDING_RETAILER_CONFIRMATION.

ship_after_max.description: Only orders whose earliest ship date is at or before this ISO 8601 timestamp, i.e. ready to ship by then.

tools.name: faire_get_order
tools.description: Get one Faire order by its ID (bo_...) with everything Faire returns: items with prices and discounts, shipping address, shipments with tracking, payout costs (commission, fees, total payout), notes and cancellation details. Use it after faire_list_orders when you need the full picture of an order. Read-only.

order_id.description: The order ID beginning with bo_, e.g. bo_bxdmjbwxid. For a display ID like #BXDMJBWXID, use bo_ plus the lower-case ID.

tools.name: faire_list_products
tools.description: List the brand's Faire products with their sale and lifecycle state and variants (variant ID, SKU, options, available quantity, wholesale and retail prices). Filter by sku or updated_at_min; pass the returned cursor to get the next page. Read-only.

cursor.description: The cursor from the previous page's response. Leave empty for the first page.

sku.description: Only the product that has a variant with this exact SKU.

updated_at_min.description: Only products updated at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

include_deleted.description: Also return deleted products. Default false.

tools.name: faire_get_product
tools.description: Get one Faire product by its ID (p_...) with its full description, images, options, every variant with prices by market, measurements, preorder and lead-time settings, and any publication warnings. Read-only.

product_id.description: The product ID beginning with p_, e.g. p_123, as returned by faire_list_products.

tools.name: faire_get_inventory_by_skus
tools.description: Get inventory for product variants by your SKUs: on-hand, committed (allocated to unfulfilled orders) and available quantity for each SKU. Use it to check stock before promising a reorder. Read-only.

skus.description: Comma-separated SKUs exactly as set on the variants, e.g. CANDLE-RED-L,CANDLE-BLUE-L.

tools.name: faire_get_inventory_by_variant_ids
tools.description: Get inventory for product variants by Faire variant ID: on-hand, committed and available quantity for each. Use it when you have variant IDs from faire_list_products or an order item rather than SKUs. Read-only.

ids.description: Comma-separated Faire product variant IDs, e.g. po_123,po_456.
